kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انعدمت (form VII)
# اِنْعَدَمْتُ (inʕadamtu) /in.ʕa.dam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْعَدَمَ (inʕadama)
# اِنْعَدَمْتَ (inʕadamta) /in.ʕa.dam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْعَدَمَ (inʕadama)
# اِنْعَدَمْتِ (inʕadamti) /in.ʕa.dam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْعَدَمَ (inʕadama)
# اِنْعَدَمَتْ (inʕadamat) /in.ʕa.da.mat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
